items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: Urbie can be heard on records with Herbie Mann, Toots Theilmans, Joe Newman and under his own leadership.

ctx.x: Urbie Green has made a career with his trombone in big bands, combos and in the recording studio. Born in Mobile, Alabama in 1926, his first major gig came in the Gene Krupa Orchestra, moving to Woody Herman’s “Third Herd” in 1951. Urbie has worked with Buck Clayton and Benny Goodman and appeared in the film of Goodman’s life. Urbie was interviewed aboard a jazz cruise in the Caribbean on May 29, 1995 by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods.
